title: Maskedire Armor
description: Makes Copper Armor Look Like Maskedire
body: ![the man himself (with the armor on duh)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d8fdda225c7cf6251733b5547e7560d97be12bd7.png)makes the copper armor into a full 3d version of maskedires skin and makes it so you can look like him ingame without downloading his skin! no mod loaders or anything needed. just download it, slide it into ur resource packs and play as maskedire! makes only copper armor look like maskedire
